Available Length: After the release of the Trilogy mixtapes, Abel went to various places around the world to perform and work on his debut album, working once again with producer Illangelo and later working with producers such as DannyBoyStyles and DaHeala. In March 2013, Abel would announce 'Kiss Land' as the title and release a handful of singles over the course of the year before the September 10th release. Kiss Land was a symbolism for the tour life according to Abel, a universe created by him to express his fear of the unknown, being inspired by horror filmmakers like John Carpenter, David Cronenberg & Ridley Scott to create a fearful, sonically unpleasant atmosphere.

Available Length: After Abel announced that he was working on "Chapter VI" in late 2018, the following year would see changes in the project's sound with long-time collaborator Illangelo returning to executive produce. At the same time, Abel and then girlfriend Bella Hadid would split up, and he would go on hiatus for a period of time. Around late 2019, Abel returned to social media, releasing two lead singles and sporting a radically different look with every music video and TV appearance in a red suit and bloody nose. 'After Hours' would release in March 2020 during the beginning of the COVID-19 lockdowns and would propel Abel to new heights on the charts for the remainder of the current decade.

Available Length: Nearly a year after the release of 'After Hours', Abel headlined Super Bowl LV as the halftime show performer, closing the curtain on the era. Abel later went right to work music inspired by crucial events in 2020 like the pandemic and the Black Lives Matter protests. This project would later be scrapped for something more lighthearted and directly follow up 'After Hours'. At the 2021 BBMA's Abel teased the new project saying that "the After Hours are over and the dawn is coming". Later in the year Abel would release the lead single "Take My Breath", and during the first week of 2022, began rolling out the album, revealing that Jim Carrey would play a crucial role in narrating the record as a purgatorial radio host.

Available Length: In 2021, it was announced that Abel would star in a new HBO series written by him, Reza Fahim, and Sam Levinson called 'The Idol'. With production starting in November 2021, the music for the show was already being prepared, but not too long after, production issues had began to arise, pausing filming until May 2022. Before filming had paused Abel had began working closely with Mike Dean on his last minute Coachella 2022 headlining show with Swedish House Mafia, ultimately reworking the project's music. 'The Idol' premeired at the Cannes Film Festival with negative reception by critics and officially began airing on HBO on June 4th, 2023. Soon after, the series was cancelled after one season.
